title: Document collection request
description: What the HRMS returns for a link code: branding, state and the documents to collect. Provider-neutral and HRMS-neutral: no HRMS field names, no assumption about which provider reads the documents. Provider credentials never appear here.

schema_version.description: Checked against the portal's supported set. An unsupported version is an error page, never a guess.

ref.description: The hrms's reference for this onboarding. Doubles as the callback Idempotency-Key; prefixed with the deployment's tenant_slug, it is the provider's client_reference_id.

goal_key.description: Which stage of the hiring flow this collection belongs to. The portal looks this up in its own goals map and passes the resulting provider goal id to the provider; an unmatched key aborts the session. Naming a stage is the hrms's to do, deciding what the stage means is the portal's, and neither can steer the other.

stage.description: Human-readable label for the same stage, echoed in the completion payload and otherwise unused.

catalogue_version.description: Identifies the document-type fixture set the hrms shipped with. Echoed in the completion payload, and logged once per collection so that a drift between the two systems shows up as a log line rather than as classification failures nobody can explain.

org_name.description: Bounded only so a malformed response cannot blow up a log line or the callback payload. Display truncation is the UI's job, never a reason to reject the collection.

copy.description: Flat map of overrides for the portal's default strings. Values interpolate {placeholder} tokens.

steps.description: An array so eSign and KYC are additive later. v1 handles exactly one step, of type document_collection.

replaced_verification_document_ids.description: Provider document ids the hrms once held and has since replaced. Never shown as unfiled again.

callback_path.description: Where the completion payload is posted, appended to the hrms base URL from the portal's own config — never to a host named here. Confined to the portal_api namespace: the payload carries a candidate's extracted identity fields, so the path may not name another whitelisted method, escape upwards, or carry a query or fragment.

^x-.description: Echoed untouched in the completion payload and otherwise ignored.

document_code.description: The HRMS's stable code for this kind of document, e.g. aadhaar_front. Names the requestedDocument on every upload and in the completion payload, so a collection lists each code once; the portal maps the provider's classifier labels onto these codes.

accept.description: File extensions. Intersected server-side with the provider's MIME whitelist; anything outside it is warned about and dropped.

max_bytes.description: Clamped to min(max_bytes, 20 MB) — the provider's hard cap.

verification_document_id.description: The provider document id the hrms currently holds for this requestedDocument. Lets the page recover which bulk upload was filed where.
